title: IDKMesh List Envelope v0.1
description: The standard paginated list response shape for IDKMesh JSON list endpoints, per docs/specifications/API_CONVENTIONS_V0_1.md section 10. Uses an opaque cursor rather than offset pagination so mutable event/run streams stay safe to page through. This envelope carries no dispatch, verification, acceptance, or merge authority -- it is a read projection only.

items.description: The page of resources. Each item's own shape is owned by the domain schema for that resource type, not by this envelope.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. Never constructed by a client; never an offset.

limit.description: The bounded page size actually applied to this response.
